proposals.impact: lift open rates on lower-performing sequences by borrowing subject-line pattern from top performer
proposals.observation: Money Vigilance emails are opening at 66.67% against 19 sends. Money Worship sits at 37.5% on 16 sends. That is a 29-percentage-point gap. The sequences serve similar list sizes, so the difference is almost certainly subject line and preview text, not audience quality. Borrowing the structural logic of the Vigilance subject line into Worship email 1 is the fastest single-file intervention available this cycle.
proposals.proposal: Open the first email in the Money Worship automation and rewrite the subject line and preview text using the same pattern the Vigilance sequence uses: a specific, uncomfortable question the reader is already asking privately, not a promise of what the email will deliver. The Worship reader tends to tie self-worth to net worth, so the subject should surface that friction directly. No change to body copy in this diff.
proposals.current_text:
subject: How your relationship with money could be holding you back
preview: Discover what money worship means and how to move forward
proposals.new_text:
subject: Do you feel like you've earned the right to finally spend it?
preview: That feeling has a name. It also has a cost Joel didn't see until his account hit £150k and he still wouldn't touch it.

proposals.impact: clear the single queued post before the queue runs dry and posting cadence breaks
proposals.observation: The content queue shows exactly one post queued against 47 published. Recent posts ran daily through early June 2026 and then stopped at 7 June. Today is 16 July. That is a 39-day gap with one post sitting unpublished. If that queued post does not go out, the site goes dark and organic search signals decay. Publishing it now costs nothing and prevents a compounding problem.
proposals.proposal: Publish the single queued post by setting its pubDate to today (2026-07-16) and confirming frontmatter status is "published". No body copy changes needed unless a two-pass audit flags a violation, in which case fix only the offending sentence.

proposals.impact: add quiz entry point to homepage to drive the first quiz session recorded in 48h
proposals.observation: The quiz recorded zero sessions and zero starts across a 48-hour window. The quiz exists and the automations downstream of it are active and sending (Money Avoidance: 19 sent, Worship: 16, Vigilance: 12), which means the list has subscribers but no new people are entering the quiz funnel right now. The homepage is the most likely entry point for cold traffic and the most likely place a quiz CTA is absent or buried.
proposals.proposal: Add a short, specific quiz call-to-action block to the homepage hero section. The copy should not promise a result. It should describe what the quiz actually does: name the money script the reader already runs, so they can see it clearly. Targeted at the 25-35 earner who suspects the problem is behavioural but cannot articulate it yet.
proposals.current_text: Understanding why you behave the way you do with money is the first step toward changing it.
proposals.new_text:
Most people earning well in their late twenties and thirties can describe their spending. Very few can name the script running underneath it. The quiz takes four minutes and gives that script a name.
